integrity_notes: The proof is analytic and self-contained; the standalone integer-arithmetic tests are corroborating checks only. No independent mathematical validation or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for nearest-integer rounding of the exactly 45-degree Euclidean rotation on the square integer lattice; it does not cover floor rounding, arbitrary angles or arbitrary lattices. Potential older rounded-rotation literature was only partially accessible; priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: One-step global periodicity and exact periodic-point density for the rounded 45-degree lattice rotation
